# Subgoal: place cyan_mug onto blue_coaster
obs = observe()
coaster = obs["zones"]["blue_coaster"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_mug")
# Filter for top-down, clear hand and fingers, fitting fingers
valid_candidates = [
    c for c in candidates
    if c.get("hand_clear", True) and c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)
]

# Prefer candidates with low tilt_deg (or geometry candidates with tilt_deg=0)
if valid_candidates:
    chosen = min(valid_candidates, key=lambda c: c.get("tilt_deg", 0))
else:
    chosen = candidates[0]

res = grasp(chosen)
if res["holding_something"]:
    carry_to(coaster["center"][0], coaster["center"][1], height=0.18)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    check("cyan_mug", "blue_coaster")

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
paper = obs["objects"]["green_paper"]
bin_zone = obs["zones"]["red_bin"]

# Find geometry candidate or construct vertical grasp at object center with sufficient depth
candidates = grasp_candidates("green_paper")
geo_cands = [c for c in candidates if c.get("source") == "geometry"]

if geo_cands:
    chosen = geo_cands[0]
    # Ensure grasp penetrates low enough to encompass crumpled paper ball
    chosen["height"] = max(0.012, min(chosen["height"], paper["height"] * 0.4))
    res = grasp(chosen)
else:
    # Fallback to direct candidate adjustment
    cand = candidates[0]
    cand["x"] = paper["center"][0]
    cand["y"] = paper["center"][1]
    cand["height"] = 0.015
    res = grasp(cand)

if not res["holding_something"]:
    # Retry with lower grasp height at center
    cand = candidates[0]
    cand["x"] = paper["center"][0]
    cand["y"] = paper["center"][1]
    cand["height"] = 0.012
    cand["yaw"] = paper["long_axis_yaw"]
    res = grasp(cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    drop_into_container(bin_zone, clear_offset=0.15, retreat_height=0.15)

check("green_paper", "red_bin")
